resume_protocol: Fetch latest main SHA, PR exact head, changed files/diff, CI and this checkpoint before editing.
Treat only committed code with passing tests as completed; never infer completion from chat history.
If main moved, compare and reconcile explicitly; never force-reset or overwrite unverified work.
Keep all v0.4.2 functional changes on this branch until the release gate passes.
Do not reintroduce subtree:true broad MutationObserver or documentElement-wide observers.
After each completed stage, update this checkpoint with commit SHA and CI evidence.
product_principle: 分享页首先是可连续阅读的考试坐标报告，不是排名海报；字号、留白、色差共同建立层级，不靠超大数字压住页面。

S0.name: Recovery baseline
requirements: Draft PR early
Preserve API/KV/auth/share-token/exam data contracts
Baseline main=f6750e90d04519cabeef31acaddcbd56ba7d1b8c and no open PRs

S1.name: Typography hierarchy
requirements: Desktop name 28-32px
Desktop primary school rank 40-44px, never above 48px
Mobile primary rank 34-38px
Class rank/score 18-20px desktop, 17-18px mobile
Subject score 24-28px desktop and 22-24px mobile

S2.name: Compact coordinate summary
requirements: Replace field-label + giant rank pattern with complete semantic unit such as 校第7名
Group school rank, class rank and total score as one exam-coordinate cluster
Keep exam name/date close to the coordinate summary

S3.name: Reduce redundant labels
requirements: Avoid 学校相对位置 -> 第7名 two-step reading when a direct 校第7名 label is possible
Do not make identity metadata compete with the coordinate summary
Do not expose internal identifiers that add no reading value

S4.name: Subject density
requirements: Desktop keeps 3x2 subject data units without card chrome
Target subject unit height about 90-105px
Mobile uses six compact rows rather than 2x3 large tiles
Subject rows remain easy to scan and tap targets remain >=44px where interactive

S5.name: Surface and width
requirements: Current exam summary keeps restrained light brand-green surface
Subject area visually steps down to white/warm-neutral
Public share content max width about 960-1040px
No oversized whitespace or page-level horizontal scroll

S6.name: Responsive behavior
requirements: PC, Pad and Android layouts have intentional rather than scaled-down behavior
360-430px preserves identity -> exam -> coordinate -> subjects reading order
Weak network must not flash legacy giant-rank layout before the compact layer applies

S7.name: Regression and release
requirements: Version exactly 0.4.2 across package.json, package-lock.json and wrangler.toml
UI contract tests lock typography caps, compact coordinate semantics, subject density and responsive rules
No backend/data-contract changes
Final exact-head CI success before Ready and merge
Main CI and Cloudflare exact-SHA deploy success
Production /api/health attests appVersion=0.4.2

release_gate: Final PR exact head passes npm run verify.
No regression to giant rank hero, oversized subject cards or broad DOM observers.
Merge with expected_head_sha only after final-head CI success.
